app.title: Eventvs Mérida
app.description: Eventvs Mérida — All cultural events in Mérida in one place.

hero.subtitle: A single app to discover culture, leisure and events in the city. For residents and travelers.

paragraphs.first: Eventvs Mérida is an Android mobile application designed to bring together, in one place, the vast majority of the city's cultural events: theatre, concerts, exhibitions, festivals and much more.
paragraphs.second: It was created as a direct response to the current difficulty of finding cultural activities scattered across different media and platforms, making participation harder for both residents and tourists.

heritage.title: Historical heritage
heritage.description: Roman Theatre, Amphitheatre, Circus… Mérida has one of the most important archaeological sites in Spain.

culture.title: Living culture
culture.description: Classical Theatre Festival, markets, exhibitions, live music and events for every taste.

features.label: What can you do?
features.description: Eventvs Mérida centralizes, organizes and presents the city's cultural events in the simplest possible way.

map.title: Interactive map
map.description: Find nearby events in real time with integrated geolocation.

calendar.title: Complete agenda
calendar.description: Calendar view with all events filtered by day.

audience.title: For residents and tourists
audience.description: Designed so both locals and visitors can enjoy the city.

details.title: Detailed information
details.description: Schedules, location, image and full description for each event.

search.title: Search and filters
search.description: Find exactly what you are looking for by category, title or location.

team.label: Who we are
team.description: Developed by three students from Mérida who want to improve access to culture in their city.

download.label: Available now
download.description: Available for Android. Download the APK directly from the releases of the official GitHub repository.

note.strong: “Install apps from unknown sources” in your Android device settings.
